stem.text: A positively charged oil droplet falls in air in a uniform electric field that is vertically upwards. The droplet has a constant terminal speed $v_0$ and the electric field strength is $E$.
The magnitude of the force due to air resistance acting on the droplet is proportional to the speed of the droplet.
Which graph shows the variation with $E$ of $v_0$?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis v0 and horizontal axis E, origin 0, showing one line.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis v0 and horizontal axis E, origin 0, showing one curve.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis v0 and horizontal axis E, origin 0, showing one curve.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis v0 and horizontal axis E, origin 0, showing one horizontal line.
